comments: Replace with any overall comment. Approving this plan also confirms the interface judgement in section 2 of the review: that no acceptance criterion in ETA-351 is API-verifiable and all eight scenarios are UI. Say so here if you disagree.

itemDecisions.comment: A way to declare the sign-in kind exists before any details are entered. UI.
Both sign-in kinds are offered and distinguishable. UI.
Choosing organization sign-in changes which details are asked for. UI. Stays abstract pending AMB-ETA-351-001.
The password is not readable on screen. UI. Uses a fabricated secret that is typed but never submitted.
Correct details reach the Home page. UI. The only scenario that uses the real organization account.
Wrong details are refused and reported. UI. Fabricated credentials only; no message text asserted.
Missing details are refused and reported. UI. No message text asserted.
The two failure responses are distinguishable. UI. Both attempts happen inside one scenario so the comparison is evidenced, not inferred.
